title: The top coefficient times a root is integral
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $n\ge0$, $a_0,\dots,a_n\in R$ and $t\in S$ with $\varphi(a_0)+\varphi(a_1)t+\dots+\varphi(a_n)t^n=0$ in $S$. Then $\varphi(a_n)t$ is integral over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]: it is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $\varphi(R)$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00PQ (lemma-make-integral-trivial, line 30481); proof: multiply the relation by $\varphi(a_n)^{n-1}$. Tag verified in literature/stacks-project/tags/tags (00PQ,algebra-lemma-make-integral-trivial).

t satisfies a_0 + a_1 t + ... + a_n t^n = 0, then a_n t is integral over R
